tasks.description: Create skill.json with complete metadata declarations
steps: Add description with persistence warning: 'Agent checkpointing and resurrection via IPFS/Solvr. Creates optional systemd/cron jobs.'
Entry 1: { name: 'SOLVR_API_KEY', description: 'Solvr API key for agent registration and pinning', required: false }
Entry 2: { name: 'PINATA_JWT', description: 'Pinata JWT for direct IPFS pinning', required: false }
Entry 3: { name: 'NOTIFY_TARGET', description: 'Telegram chat ID for resurrection notifications', required: false }
Add persistence object with createsSystemdUnits: true, createsCronJobs: true, createsIdentityFiles: true
Add networkAccess object listing api.solvr.dev, api.pinata.cloud, IPFS gateways
Add dataExposed: 'Checkpoints contain workspace files, memory, config. Plaintext by default.'
Verify: cat skill/skill.json | jq . validates as JSON
Create skill/scripts/ directory if not exists
Test: bash skill/scripts/checkpoint.sh --help shows usage or runs without error
Test: bash skill/scripts/resuscitate.sh --help shows usage or runs without error
Test: bash skill/scripts/init.sh --help shows usage or runs without error
Test: bash skill/scripts/learning.sh --help shows usage or runs without error
Test: bash skill/scripts/solvr-integration.sh --help shows usage or runs without error
Test: bash skill/scripts/status.sh shows status output
Test: bash skill/scripts/pin-to-solvr.sh --help shows usage or runs without error

tasks.description: Copy remaining utility scripts into skill package
steps: Identify any scripts not yet copied (full-checkpoint.sh, smart-checkpoint-*.sh, etc.)
Copy each remaining .sh file to skill/scripts/
Verify: ls skill/scripts/*.sh shows all scripts

tasks.description: Update SKILL.md to remove git clone instructions
steps: Replace with: 'Scripts are bundled in this skill package at scripts/'
Update any paths from external repo to local skill/scripts/ paths
Remove any curl | bash install patterns
Verify: grep -i 'git clone' skill/SKILL.md returns nothing
Add header: '# Security & Data Flow Documentation'
Add section: '## Data Collected' listing all files included in checkpoints
List: SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, USER.md, TOOLS.md, memory/*.md, identity.json, config.json
Add section: '## Data NOT Collected' listing excluded files
List: OpenClaw config (API keys), AgentMemory vault, system files outside workspace
Add section: '## Network Endpoints' listing all contacted services
List: api.solvr.dev (registration, pinning), api.pinata.cloud (direct IPFS), IPFS gateways
Add section: '## Persistent Components' listing systemd/cron created
Add section: '## Encryption' noting plaintext default, --encrypt option coming
Add section: '## How to Audit' with commands to inspect scripts before running
Add section: '## How to Uninstall' with cleanup commands
Verify: cat skill/SECURITY.md shows complete documentation
Add argument parsing: if [[ $1 == '--encrypt' ]]; then ENCRYPT=true; shift; fi
After tarball creation, add encryption block
If ENCRYPT=true: generate random 32-byte key with openssl rand -hex 32
Encrypt tarball: openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -salt -in checkpoint.tar.gz -out checkpoint.tar.gz.enc -pass pass:$KEY
Save key to ~/.amcp/checkpoint-keys.json with CID as key
Pin encrypted file instead of plaintext
Update output to show 'Encrypted checkpoint' when --encrypt used
After downloading checkpoint, detect if encrypted (check file magic or .enc extension)
If encrypted and --key-file provided: decrypt with openssl
If encrypted and no --key-file: look up key in ~/.amcp/checkpoint-keys.json by CID
If key not found: error with 'Checkpoint is encrypted. Provide --key-file or ensure key exists in ~/.amcp/checkpoint-keys.json'
Decrypt: openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -d -in checkpoint.tar.gz.enc -out checkpoint.tar.gz -pass pass:$KEY

tasks.description: Create GitHub Actions workflow for signed releases
steps: Step 2: Create tarball: tar -czvf proactive-amcp-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz skill/
Step 3: Generate SHA256: sha256sum proactive-amcp-*.tar.gz > proactive-amcp-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz.sha256
Step 4: Create GitHub Release using softprops/action-gh-release@v1
Add body: 'SHA256 checksum included. Verify with: sha256sum -c proactive-amcp-*.sha256'
Test: push tag v0.8.0 and verify release created with artifacts

tasks.description: Test bundled skill installs without external fetch
steps: Copy skill/ folder to test directory
Simulate ClawdHub install by running: ls skill/scripts/*.sh
Verify all required scripts present: proactive-amcp.sh, checkpoint.sh, resuscitate.sh, init.sh
Run skill/scripts/proactive-amcp.sh status (should work without git clone)
Verify: grep -r 'git clone' skill/ returns nothing
Verify: no network calls needed for script availability

tasks.description: Test skill.json is valid and complete

steps: Create test workspace with SOUL.md, MEMORY.md
Verify: key automatically found and checkpoint decrypted
Run: npm version 0.8.0 --no-git-tag-version (if not already updated)
Verify: npm view proactive-amcp version returns 0.8.0
Verify skill/scripts/ contains all bundled scripts
Verify: clawdhub search proactive-amcp shows v0.8.0

tasks.description: Create GitHub release v0.8.0 with signed artifacts
steps: Commit all changes: git add -A && git commit -m 'v0.8.0: Security hardening'
Verify release page has tarball and SHA256 file

tasks.description: Re-run security analysis and verify reduced warnings
steps: Submit updated skill to same security analyzer that flagged issues
Verify: 'undeclared env vars' warning resolved (skill.json declares them)
Verify: 'external code fetch' warning resolved (scripts bundled)
Verify: 'persistence not declared' warning resolved (skill.json has persistence object)
Document any remaining warnings for future work
If VirusTotal still flags: document as expected behavior (legitimate agent automation)
